title: From an answer, practice (Set the pivot already learned): Shake Control, a null that expressions move and that carries the rock and the letters, is the focus with no intent question; a Pan Behind that also moved rock.png gets a hint naming rock.png and its way (no fail words, no review); the clean Pan Behind passes on the layers it carries not moving, and the last line hands back to the next step

steps.text: Open Shake Control's Position expression and look at how it sets each hit's size: it uses the first hit's size for all three. Not something I teach yet.
Open Shake Control's Rotation expression and look at its amounts: 0.75° at most. Not something I teach yet.
Select Shake Control (the null, not a letter) and Pan Behind its pivot to where the hammer hits.
Play it back and watch the turn.

turns.say: I used Pan Behind on it. Done.
I undid that and did it again with Pan Behind. Done.
The hammer end stays still. That's all for now.
